readable_name: meteor MechET compact-history checkpoint-10000 validation-32 smoke BF16 (8xA100 QY)
task_description: BF16 rerun of the development-only matched closed-loop smoke after the first task exposed a missing bitsandbytes package before evaluating any row. Uses 32 deterministic FlowER validation reactions. GPUs 0-3 evaluate the parent natural-language State-SFT; GPUs 4-7 evaluate compact-history Trajectory-SFT checkpoint-10000. Both use identical product-only inputs, real executor transitions, frozen state-value critic, reaction IDs and search budget. Runtime history is reconstructed only from accepted predicted actions; gold history and the test split are never loaded. This is not a headline benchmark result.
